kind: Invented exact teaching fixtures, separate from Tonmick
sampling: Uniform choice of two of four equal-size colleges, complete outcomes within selected colleges; selected-record rate targets the full equal-size frame rate.
assignment: Two offers selected uniformly within each four-person college, independently across two colleges. Fixed outcomes under the sharp null of no individual effect and no interference. Compare the absolute offered-minus-no-offer difference inclusively.
pooled_comparison: Deliberately different rule allocating four offers among eight; report as a comparison of reference sets, not as the declared experiment.
model: Binomial event-count probability for four independent common-probability trials with one event; compare p=0.25 and p=0.50. Ratio of count likelihoods.
print_rule: Exact counts; proportions as stated percentages, p values to four decimals, likelihood ratio to four decimals.
exposure: Exact answers follow from declared inputs and enumeration. No blind preregistration claim; no World draws.
